title: Overhung or Center Hung Sorter
description: The learner sorts twelve described fan arrangements by impeller position and bearing location and gets the reason plus a side-view schematic with the airstream shaded after each card.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: overhung impeller

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Impeller position and bearing location by arrangement
learningObjectives: The learner will classify twelve fan arrangements as overhung or center hung and state whether each arrangement's bearings sit in or out of the airstream, from a one-line description of each arrangement.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); verdicts announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs and solid/dashed borders pair with colour; option buttons use aria-pressed with a ✓ prefix; keys 1-2 impeller, 3-5 bearings, Enter checks or goes to the next card.

controls.label: All out of airstream / At least one in airstream / No fan bearings
Check
controls.purpose: Check the card once both choices are made (Enter)

controls.label: Next card
controls.purpose: Next card; See results after card 12 (Enter)

controls.label: Retry missed
controls.purpose: Practice round over the missed cards (not scored)

rules: A card is correct only when both the impeller position and the bearing location match
No partial credit; the feedback names the wrong field
Cards 6 (Arrangement 4) and 10 (Arrangement 8) marked center hung add the direct-drive note
assumptions: Standard (non-inlet-box) single width fans draw air through the inlet on the side away from the drive
limitations: Schematics are simplified side views, not Twin City Fan drawings

sources: FanPedia p. 30 (impeller orientation), p. 79 (shaft overview), pp. 162–168 (arrangement technical descriptions)

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Two-way classification from a description, with the schematic as feedback linking geometry to bearing exposure
keyQuestions: Where is the impeller, and where are the bearings?
commonMisconceptions: Arrangement 4 has fan bearings in the airstream
Every Arrangement 3 has its bearings out of the airstream
Center hung fans always have a bearing in the airstream, even with inlet boxes
assessmentOpportunities: Running line 'Correct: n of 12'; mastery is 10 of 12 on the first attempt.
